cohort: 2641 children from a Dutch birth cohort study with prenatal inclusion in 1996 and 1997
finding: Children born by cesarean delivery had a 52% higher risk of being overweight throughout childhood compared to those delivered vaginally, but this was not associated with higher blood pressure in adolescence.
mod_finding: Children born by cesarean delivery had a 52% higher risk of being overweight throughout childhood compared to those delivered vaginally.
